batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b DS Kulkarni

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b DS Kulkarni

batting.name: SR Watson
batting.dismissal: c DR Smith b KA Pollard

balls.text: Kulkarni has done well to stop this one at third man, it was a thick edge as Shah tried to swing it over square leg from outside off, Kulkarni almost overrran it as it bounced to his left and then turned across him, stopped it fine in the end
he's got him with the slower one, Yagnik had made room outside leg stump, but was done in by the sudden fall in pace, only spooned it up high in the air, Malinga settled under it
fine flick, Malinga hurls it fullish outside leg stump, and Yagnik puts it away behind square
how did he get bat down on that., it was in the blockhole, headed for middle, Shah is outside leg stump, and manages to run it to third man
goes for the yorker on the stumps, not quite in the blockhole, Shah drills it in the air down the ground, long on fields and hits the stumps at the non-striker's, Yagnik has made it
carves a pitched up ball over point
slams a pitched up ball just outside off, straight down the ground, Pollard saves the boundary running across from long on
way too wide with the angle across the left-hander

Kulkarni has another wicket, Menaria opens up to a near-yorker, and digs it out low to Kulkarni, who takes it well, and claims it immediately, they check the replays, find that the catch carried cleanly, and that Menaria had got to the ball on the full, he has to go this time
tries to launch this pitched up wide ball over extra cover, mistimes it high in the air, Harbhajan runs back hard, but it sails just over him, he fields it on the bounce
slams a low full toss to midwicket, Harbhajan misfields and they get the run
full and wide delivery again, not called this time, Menaria reached out for it, did he get some bat on it
way too wide with the angle across the left-hander
another slow length ball, the yorker has to be on the batsman's mind against Malinga, Menaria recovers to awkwardly get it down to third man
the slow length ball, pacy yorkers, slow length balls, too steep a difference, Shah guides it to third man
digs out a yorker around off to long off

there is the yorker, and there is the wicket, or is it, Menaria making some room just outside leg stump, Malinga finds leg stump with the yorker, Menaria's bat came down late, but he will survive, Malinga has overstepped, Menaria puts his gloves back
pitched up delivery just outside off crashed off the front foot to sweeper cover
opens up, probably expecting the yorker, it is a length ball on leg, though, and he adjusts to push it towards cover
Malinga starts with a yorker right away, just outside off, Shah just manages to squeeze it down to third man
very well handled by Shah, yorker just outside off stump, he opens the face late to run it to third man
not quite a free hit this one, drills it a very low full toss on the stumps to long on
Menaria has upper cut this one for six wide of third man, and it is a no-ball as well, he was in the air as he played the shot
gets across and squeezes a very full one down to long on
full ball mistimed down to long on
that has been sliced in the gap between third man and sweeper cover, wide and pitched up, he opens the face and lofts it over point
goes for the yorker but sends it full down the leg side
pushes a length ball on the off side
this is what he has been looking to do, succeeds this time, Watson wallops them over deep midwicket, Shah swings them over deep square, from outside off, for six

Malinga has made a mess of this chance at deep square, again Shah picked it up from outside off and swung it over square leg, Malinga could not judge it as it came down, ended up having to dive as it approached him, put it down tamely in the end and it rolled into the rope
stands a long way outside leg stump, Pollard delivers it on a length on leg stump, Shah cannot punch it past extra cover
guides a back of a length ball to sweeper cover
fetches it from well outside off and swings it behind square leg
stands outside leg, Pollard follows him, Shah walks just inside the line, earns a wide
cuts one going across him outside off, to sweeper cover
defended down the pitch, superb comeback over from Harbhajan
comes out to a flighted ball which turns away from him, reaches out and manages to spoon it over extra cover
cannot get it away again, plays out a length ball towards point
pushed to the off side
tosses it up again, on a length on off stump, beats Menaria's forward prod with more turn
some turn as he tosses it up on middle, defended off a thick edge towards point
Pollard has the big wicket, Watson tries to wallop this one over deep midwicket, it bounced from just back of a length, and Watson's front-foot heave comes down in wide long on's hands
with fine leg up, Pollard delivers an offcutter down the pads, Watson easily swats it past the fielder
mistimes a push for a single to long on
wide, too far wide outside the off stump and moving further away, Shah cannot reach it

Shah played a few of these strokes earlier this season, tries to swing a length ball from outside off behind square leg, takes it on the pad as he misses, Pollard finds that worth a shout, it hit Shah well outside off
angled in to the pad from wide of the crease, he cannot turn it away fine
that was going to go, slow offcutter wide outside off from Pollard, Watson fetched it with his massive reach and cracked it high over deep midwicket
spooned in the air but he knew that mid-on was back
on a yorker length and he pushes it down to long-on
on the pads and he works it away to deep square leg
swings away and he gets behind it and pushes it to long-off
pushes it to long-on
finally manages to get the single with a push in front of point
Pollard getting Mumbai back with a tight over, Shah can only tap this length ball towards point
slow length ball pushed in the same direction again
pushed softly to midwicket

oh dear, Binny has managed to run himself out, he missed the work on the leg side and charged out for the single as the ball rolled off pad down the pitch, but barged straight into the huge frame of Pollard, by the time he turned around, Pollard had strode towards the ball, and it needed just a kick from him to roll onto the stumps, Binny was just short, with Pollard between him and the stumps
reaches out a a wide one and drags it down to mid off
the length balls with a bit of angle into him are in the slot for him to wallop over midwicket, mistimes this one along the ground
shuffles across, brings bat in front of pad, gets it straight to short fine, Watson dives in, Sachin's throw misses by a long way
tries to repeat the shot again, this one is hurled in towards the leg stump, and it races through midwicket off the inner part of the bat
he's connected on the third attempt, and has slogged Smith for six over deep midwicket
tries to stay back and steer a rising back of a length ball, beaten
beaten by some inward movement as he tries to clobber a length ball down the ground
changes the line to outside off stump, Binny gets forward without fuss and times it wide of sweeper cover
Binny taking Harbhajan apart with ease, Harbhajan keeps it full on leg, now Binny goes down on his knee to slog-sweep over deep square leg
fires it down the leg side again, Watson did not make room, he missed the sweep, and the keeper cannot collect the wide
fires it full outside leg stump, he steps out for the third time in a row and drills it to deep square
tosses it up on leg now, but Binny has made room and lofted it just out of the reach of extra cover
skips out, stops as Harbhajan drags it slightly short and widish, Binny recovers to steer it to the third man boundary
lunges forward on a knee and sweeps a flat delivery on middle to deep square
slightly short and he pulls hard, but down to long on
almost takes out the bowler, with a powerful straight punch, Smith gets his hands in front of his face just in time, the ball pops out and rolls away, Smith does a reverse somersault as he falls back
lack of pace makes him mistime an attempted drive off the front foot
that should have gone, short, wide, at 130 kph, he mistimes the cut to point
short of a length, angled in, and worked in front of square leg
gets forward and square drives this full and wide one, point takes some pace off it with a dive
goes deep in the crease to one fired in towards the pads, works it to square leg
now he opens the face against the turn and pushes it to cover
gives him width outside off stump with a full delivery, and Binny fetches it on a knee and hammers it over wide long on
slower, flighted more, and dipping on him as he comes forward, nudged towards midwicket
quicker and fuller, into off and middle, pushed down to long on
defends a tossed up ball off the front foot
width available on this full delivery, Watson gets forward and thumps it straight to sweeper cover
length ball ending just outside off, tapped to point
short ball arrives now, Watson ducks
flicked away, couple of bounces to the deep midwicket boundary, he is on the front foot to the fullish ball on off, reaches out a bit and times it over the infield wristily
pushes a length ball towards cover
shot! it was pitched up, but not quite full, not quite wide, Watson pushes forward, opens the face and drives it just to the left of mid off, who cannot stop it with a dive
pushes a pitched up ball back to the bowler
pushed to point
punches a back of a length ball to cover
sharp short delivery angled into him right away, he manages to get out of the way
pulled hard and pulled straight to shortish midwicket, short ball, Rahane goes hard for the pull but cannot place it wide of the fielder
pitched up, he stays in the crease and punches to cover

Watson tries to get tonk this straight pitched up delivery down the ground, has to reach out a bit, and that is why he does not time it well enough to reach the rope, Sachin runs from mid on and pulls it back
slower one, pitched up outside off, he runs it to third man
short and angled in, he shuffles and works it to short fine, Kulkarni cannot stop it cleanly
pushes forward to a pitched up ball, thick edge rolls to point
slow length ball outside off, he waits on it and guides it to third man
pushes a length ball to point
slight width from a good length, just a bit, and that is enough for Watson to get the front foot out and hit it over extra cover, just rolls into the rope to beat the chasing fielder
stays in the crease and works a length ball through midwicket, deep square runs across to field
shuffles across and works the length ball with the angle into him, to deep square
length ball pushed towards mid on
slightly short, pulled away but to midwicket
Kulkarni bowls another jaffa to Watson, angled in on a good length, swinging away late and beating the outside edge, lots of bounce again, he does this all the time in domestic cricket

Rahane wants the single, he is halfway down the pitch before he turns back as the fielder gets to the ball close to the pitch on the off side, the throw misses, Rahane might have just made it with a big dive had there been a direct hit
pitched up this time, and moving in all the time, he brings bat well in front of pad to push it on the leg side
good length, swinging in, ending just outside off, he shuffles, opens up and blocks softly
worked away to short fine leg's left, and goes right through his hands, Malinga messing up
more inswing, but well down the leg side off a good length
did not pick it up cleanly, but manages to swing this shortish delivery over square leg, off the front foot
caught on the crease as it swings back in from a length, cannot work it away, slip raises his hands in appeal, that was sliding easily down leg
guides this one outside off to point
lovely delivery from Kulkarni, it is angled in back of a length, Watson shapes up to defend, it then moves away and beats the outside edge, that curled away a lot, top delivery

Kulkarni strikes in his first over, another wide delivery, but there has been lots of bounce for him, Dravid reaches out to try and cut, only manages a thick edge to the keeper, did not move his feet much there, just reached out awkwardly with the bat
goes for the cut to a wide delivery and is beaten as it bounces too much
pitched up nicely, and moves away a tad, eased out to cover
called a wide, harshly, Rahane had a go at this short of a length ball as it moved away to beat him by some margin
tight line on a good length, just outside off, he taps it softly towards point
on the pads and he puts it away in front of square leg
bounce this time as it zips across him from short of a length, he hangs his bat at an angle as he weaves out of the way
full and swinging in down the leg side, Dravid misses by a long way as he looks to flick it
worked in front of square on leg
wide, and short as well, Rahane cannot find any timing on it as he throws his bat at it
opens up and defends as this back of a length ball straightens a shade, probably he was expecting it to come back in even more, off a thick edge to point
pushes a pitched up ball on the off side and is away
and it is over with a wide down the leg side
Tait tries another yorker, Smith scrambles to get it towards mid on
tries the yorker, Smith almost falls over as he sends it through square leg
pitched up ball neatly driven with a bit of an open face, mid off stops it with a dive
inside edge onto pads, rolls on to the leg side
whips a very full one swinging in on middle to midwicket
another mistimed stroke as Smith goes hard at this one, falls short of sweeper cover, Tendulkar wanted two, had to turn back, would still have been gone had keeper gathered the throw, if he had
and some response from Tendulkar, he gets forward to a pitched up delivery and times it past sweeper cover
Watson still manages to produce a ripper, angled in, pitching around off on a length, and straightens to beat the open face of the bat
goes for the yorker, squeezed out from around off to midwicket
length ball awkwardly pushed past the non-striker to long on
misses the work on the leg side off the pad
dabs a wide delivery in the air down to third man
ducks under a shortish one
Smith sticks to his method, the same shot produced a top edge and a reprieve last ball, this time he wrists it powerfully behind square leg

i have lost count of the top-edges today, this is probably the 37th, maybe the 41st, and Rajasthan have put down another catch, can't even call it that, Tait was nowhere near the ball as he dived in vain as it came down
shuffles a long way across and turns it wide of fine leg
worked off the pads square on leg

drops it close to the stumps, and they take the single by the time the keeper gets to the ball, Tendulkar has a fifty, with Smith going strong at the other end, he's had the space to score a few runs before the eliminator
worked in front of square from deep in the crease
nudges a full one off the pad to short fine
beaten as he tries to cut a length ball that skids in
the tossed up wrong 'un, he misses the sweep and is hit in front, but that pitched outside leg
too short, too flat, and he rocks back to thump it to the deep midwicket rope
fine stroke! he's got to the line of one outside off and driven it well wide of sweeper cover
hangs back in the crease and flicks the length ball to deep square
the shortish delivery got much closer to him than he anticipated, he adjusted late to run it to third man
leading edge on the off side as he tries to work it square on leg
drags it from outside off wide of deep midwicket

candidate for shot of the day, for the manner in which it was played, not a conventional pull, he's just wristed the short ball, from a mile outside off, on one leg too, and it has crashed into the deep midwicket rope
punches a length ball to sweeper cover
once more, the keeper is having a hard time today, Tait, Trivedi, now Tait sends it fast down leg again
Tait is back, and right away he hurls it full and wide down leg
Chandila's nightmare continues, now he lets it slip through his hands at deep midwicket and it rolls into the rope, it wasn't hit as well as the previous stroke from Smith
slow, flat, and shortish, pulled hard to deep midwicket, who fumbles and allows a second
makes room and mistimes it down to long off
slower one sits up outside off from a length, and Sachin thumps it over extra cover
tackles the bounce on this back of a length ball with a forcing punch to sweeper cover
makes room, does not quite get hold of the length ball, but forces it away to sweeper cover
they run for a leg bye as Smith missed the work square on leg
now he walks across, looking to swing it behind square leg from middle stump, mistimes it in front of square
beaten as he tries to force away a rising back of a length ball
backs away and heaves the free hit length ball wide of deep square leg, it hasn't been pretty, it has been chancy, but MI have a century opening partnership

Smith gives Rajasthan another opportunity, and finally Rajasthan take it, but wait, it is just not happening for them today, Trivedi has taken the catch, but before that, he's overstepped, Smith survives after top-edging an attempted swat behind square leg
pushed to mid off
reaches forward and lifts it softly down to long on
flicks a low full to the right of deep midwicket for Smith to bring up his fifty
dabs it late from off to short third man
dropped by the bowler, Smith drilled a full toss straight back at him, it was hit powerfully though
and again, hardly anything on his deliveries, no spin, no bite, Smith powers it over wide long on from around off stump
Chandila delivers an innocuous delivery, length on off, Smith cracks it without fuss over deep midwicket
beaten by the quick wrong 'un now, he wanted to have a go, had made room outside leg, but this one zipped across wide outside off, and he was too far from the ball in the end
hurled it straight into the blockhole, Sachin was making rooom, and had to dig it out to the bowler, Hogg is enjoying this
makes room and cuts it off middle to sweeper cover

he continues to survive, Dravid smiles, so does Hogg, and Sachin, who walked outside off to try and paddle it fine on the leg side, it rushed across with the angle, got a shade big on him, and he awkwardly top-edged it over and past slip
turns in from a length on middle, pushed down to long on
opens the face and squeezes a skiddy pitched up ball on off towards point
eases a 104 kph length ball to sweeper cover
pushed off the back foot to the bowler
that is a wristy slap, that is picked from a good length, and Smith's right wrist comes into play to turn it behind square leg
Tendulkar gets away again, a leading edge this time as he looks to work a length ball square on leg, falls wide of midwicket
cannot time the drive to a pitched up ball, hits it back to the bowler
the wrong 'un, Tendulkar was getting forward initially, waits on it a bit and cuts, straight through point, Hogg does not like that, he screams in frustration
driven wide of long off for a couple
dropped, Sachin goes for the sweep, the top edge loops up in the air, deep midwicket races in, Watson even gets to it with a dive forward  but it goes through his hands
away to deep square off the pad
worked square on the leg side
was looking to go leg side, adjusted in the end to squeeze it from outside off to short third man, Hogg smiles
hangs his bat out at a wide delivery, thick edge falls well short of Tait at third man
punches a length ball crisply wide of sweeper cover
and again he sends it down the leg side with the angle and some inswing, this time Yagnik, standing up, cannot bail him out, neither can fine leg
another one moves in from a good length, he hurriedly defends back to the bowler
works a length ball from off through square leg
that has moved back into him with the angle, and beaten the inside edge, not far from the stumps as well
way down the leg side, Yagnik does well to get a glove to it
forced away past point to sweeper cover

beats him with the one that carries across the right-hander, tossed up, draws him into a big drive, and beats him, Yagnik cannot gather it cleanly, was Smith's back foot out? Yes, it was, for an instant
defended off the front foot
goes deep in the crease and works it square on the leg side
that hurried onto him from a length as he made room to punch, pushes to extra cover
this one is in the slot for the sweep, tossed up full on leg stump, and Sachin forces the sweep past square leg
tries to sweep from outside off first ball, misses, there is an appeal for lbw, he was hit well outside the line of off
another boundary for Smith, Tait going short again, and this time he gets a lot more bat on it to pull it into the deep midwicket rope
Smith is going after them, he is not connecting well but still getting some runs, this time he lofts it over extra cover, fielder dives and tries to pull it back but it rolls into the rope
gets too far across and cannot work it away square on the leg side, rolls down the pitch
mistimes the pull off a 145.5 kph shortish ball, two fielders after it as it loops over midwicket, it beats them both
gets bat down in time to defend a 147.4 kph length ball on off
gets it on target, full and swinging away late on off stump, squeezed off a thick edge to third man
Tait's radar continues to be awry, full, wide and moving further away outside off
he's got hold of it this time, full and moving away, but wide, and he gets to the line and lifts it in the air over point
goes after a widish one, misses
Watson getting it to move around, as always, pitched on a a length outside off and zipped away from Smith's poke
eases a pitched up ball with an open face to square third man
punched wide of extra cover
that was an inside edge, but it fell just in front of the keeper, Smith looking to force one from the crease, but it nipped back in
after three consecutive wides from Tait, Tendulkar mistimes his third successive stroke, bends the knee looking for the drive, cannot time it at all
mistimes it again, tries to punch it away on the off side, it rolls down the pitch
bottom-edges a cut into the ground
shot! when Tait gets it full just outside off, for once, he gets the front foot out and squeezes it past extra cover
third time on the trot, hurls it down the leg side
sends it wide down leg once again
hurls it full and wide down leg with the angle
that has fallen in front of fine leg running across, Smith looking to swat a back of a length ball square, gets away with the top edge
worked on the leg side for one
punches a length ball outside off to extra cover
coming in from back of a length, and he uses the angle to work it past short fine leg
pitched up just outside off, he is a tad late in getting forward and pushes it to mid off
now one that skids into him from back of a length, he misses and takes it high on the pad
beaten first up with one that holds its line just outside off from back of a length
pushes a quicker one to long on
there goes Smith, picks up the fullish straight ball and belts it straight down the ground
not much turn for him, but right on off from a length, pushed to the bowler
fuller delivery, pushed crisply past the bowler to long on
another steady length ball punched from the crease to mid off
steady offbreak on a good length, slight turn on off, worked on the leg side
